newsitem.title: CHINA: China seeks to cool stock market speculation.
newsitem.headline: China seeks to cool stock market speculation.

text.p: Chinese authorities issued a commentary on Thursday aimed at halting short-term speculation in China's volatile stock markets, saying this was the aim of a ban on Wednesday on trading in shares by state-owned firms.

"It is international common practice to restrict short-term speculation and encourage long-term investment in the stock market, which is precisely the aim of the regulation," said the commentary carried in major newspapers.

The commentary said a recent revival of excessive speculation in China's stock market could be linked to the speculative activities of a number of state-owned enterprises and listed companies, which used bank loans or money raised from issue of shares to buy stocks.

"This kind of phenomenon, if tolerated, will not only affect normal production and management and cause the loss of state assets, but also disrupt the order of the financial and securities markets and hurt investor interests," the commentary said.
